unreached.reason: No gesture can reach it. The wrap buttons appear only while sequence messages are selected, and commitWrap keeps only selected routes named edge-N, but the sequence renderer names every message seqmsg:<line>. So it refuses with "Could not locate the selected messages in the source." before this write; sequence-wrap-of-two-selected-messages-reports-them-not-located records that refusal. A pre-existing defect, reported, not fixed (PR-5).
unreached.ruling: Accepted (controller, Ruling U-W10, 2026-11-15). No gesture can reach this write at R0. The wrap buttons exist only in the sequence group Properties (buildGroupProps). commitWrap keeps only selected routes named edge-N (edge:N, edge_N). On a sequence diagram findEditableRoutes keeps only seqmsg:N routes, the type switch clears the selection, and undo history is kept per type. So every wrap refuses with "Could not locate the selected messages in the source." before the write (fixture sequence-wrap-of-two-selected-messages-reports-them-not-located). Task 15 converts the write line by line, keeps the refusal byte-identical, and does not repair the matching: a repair changes sealed behaviour and needs its own ruling. The C4 dynamic view wraps through the core's wrapSteps (spec §5.3), not through this rewrite.
